name: osda
description: OSDA — One Step Drives All. Sustainability questionnaire + AI chatbot (EN/PT).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check:carbon: diff -q backend/src/data/carbon.ts frontend/src/data/carbon.ts && echo carbon.ts in sync
